contribution.method:
Batch of 292 witnesses in 44 of the new problems (prisms and antiprisms 218, Archimedean 51, Catalan 23; `MANIFEST.json` + `records/<record_id>.json` + `SUMMARY.tsv`), each below the current `records/SUMMARY_families.csv` entry (main at a9a1af36, checked 2026-11-12). Every record passes `verify_general.py` (VALID) and `certify_general.py` (CERTIFIED) locally, run on the files extracted from the archive. The changes against the current records: median -1.19 %, largest -7.15 %; 160 records improve by ≥ 1 %, 267 by ≥ 0.1 %.

**Other values compared.** Each record is also at least 1e-4 (relative) below the value in `state/best` at the same commit and below PolyPack's published value (https://github.com/sinkomr/PolyPack, `data/polyhedra/records.json`, fetched 2026-11-12; 292 of these records have a PolyPack value, listed in `SUMMARY.tsv` as `polypack_s`). There were no open submissions for these problems.

**How the records were made.** `found_by`, `credit` and `method` identify where each record starts; `method` or `refinement` gives the steps.

- *Constructions* (219): structured packings with all pieces in a few fixed orientations. For prisms in a cube (139), the prisms are axis-parallel and stacked in up to three slabs, each layer filled with rows of the cross-section. For a solid in itself (80), all pieces are translates on a lattice generated by face-to-face contacts, or (prisms) layers of a planar packing of the cross-section; for most, the positions were then optimised by a translational linear program with the orientations fixed. 216 of them carry the exact value of the construction in `closed_form_conjecture` (with `closed_form_note`); these are upper bounds from the construction, not optimality claims.
- *Refinements of catalogue records* (61): a contact-preserving descent (sequential linear programming with the contacts as inequalities) started from the catalogue record named in `refinement`; for some, a randomised multi-start search from perturbed copies of

refinement: starting from ddoinddo_n10 (catalogue at 294b96ac): randomised multi-start search started from perturbed copies of that configuration
